children.text: by: Keilani DeSilva, Jordis Magness, Madeline Ohman

Dedication is when you commit your time, energy, and hard work towards a goal or purpose. When looking at the dedication of influencers, we look at the consistency of posting, persona, and the type of content to truly observe their dedication towards a certain cause. Across all of our influencers, dedication is displayed towards a certain cause including relatability, religious beliefs, and helping the community. For Alix Earle, her dedication is seen with her openness and honesty about her skin and the insecurities that came along with it. This allowed for her audience to appreciate and relate to her. For Pastor Paul Drees, his dedication is shown by use of the Bible and his constant support by those looked down by the loud minority as he attempts to deconstruct harmful views and shows others that the Bible, at its heart, teaches the radical love of Jesus Christ. For Serena Neel, her dedication is shown by doing a large-scale absurd, bizarre task that ultimately helps and brings together the community while also staying true to her content. Despite the clear difference in our influencers, they all emphasize a drive towards helping others before themselves. Because of their dedication towards building the community, their audiences's are able to connect with them through social media. The dedication of influencers are important now in the present because changing their persona or content can cause certain audiences to pull back. With our influencers, they express a common theme of dedication throughout their content, thus remaining relatable and reliable for their audience and future audiences.
